blast_stress_adaptation.transform: Replace platform includes; add per-instance opt-in physical operator options, declared convergence tolerance and read-only bond wrench hooks. Legacy options remain unchanged.
blast_stress_adaptation.sectionsOperator: Minimum complementary energy via physical full6x6 interface stiffness; solve-only per-sample damage; exact normalized continuation; fresh original B-transpose residual admission
blast_stress_adaptation.residualMeaning: Normal-equation gradient in mass/length-scaled coordinates; not force or torque units.

blast_authoring_adaptation.transform: Two packing helpers use Vec4V temporaries and upstream Vec4V_From_Vec3V conversion before unchanged V4Transpose. No authoring algorithm changes.

scope: Isolated installed-baseline PhysX/Flow plus opt-in Blast stress

sectionNumericsV3.scope: First-party binary64 independent-component minimum-energy solver. Anchored components use complete sparse block-Cholesky row whitening; free components use a range-preserving right preconditioner and twice-reorthogonalized directions under the original LS norm. Original physical1/sections2 processors remain unchanged.
sectionNumericsV3.operator: A=B*S using the same prepared float32 B coefficients and normalized physical Cholesky right factor S. Accepted factor coefficients and all private vector/matrix/norm operations use binary64. S uses one common scalar normalization across every bond.
sectionNumericsV3.factorAdmission: Retain all-finite factor casts and nonzero float32 physical Cholesky diagonal modes after native row permutation; no regularization, epsilon clipping, or physical mode removal.
sectionNumericsV3.rowWhitening: For anchored mobile rows, equilibrate diagonal coordinates of G=A*A^T, select deterministic exact block minimum-degree ordering, and retain complete unshifted Cholesky fill. Every pivot must be positive and finite. Physical anchor rows remain identity. For a free component, the same factor covers the principal Gram excluding its first node, whose positive six-row Gram diagonal completes an SPD numerical matrix C; all physical rows remain in A.
sectionNumericsV3.minimumEnergy: Invertible anchored row transformations retain the consistent feasible set. Detached components keep the original inertia-weighted least-squares norm and range(A^T) direction space; no rank threshold, nullspace projection, pivot shift, artificial support or physical mode removal. Topology changes reset the private solution.
sectionNumericsV3.admission: Original unweighted B^T*(b-A*x), freshly recomputed in binary64, must satisfy the unchanged actual float32 relative tolerance times the original RHS norm. A failed fresh check restarts directions without erasing the range-valid solution. Public wrench storage remains float32 and independent comparison must account for its representation separately.
sectionNumericsV3.iterationBudget: Each configured iteration sweep permits at most one update per active disconnected component. Max25 sweeps per call, unchanged caller32-pass bound; per-component update count is therefore at most800. Summed updates, reorthogonalization projections and retained numeric payload bytes are separately exposed; they are not hidden in the sweep count.
sectionNumericsV3.compatibility: The old configure_sections export still selects exact revision2. Revision3 has a separate opt-in export, revision getter/progress identity, and requires separately versioned Engine checkpoints.
sectionNumericsV3.validationStatus: Range-preserving free right-preconditioner candidate. Independent captured975-node free-island CPU proof passes original gradient/energy/traction criteria in13 updates; fresh native/parity/captured and evolving live gates remain required.
sectionNumericsV3.zeroLoad: An exactly unloaded component resets to its zero minimum-energy solution, including partial unload in a disconnected family. Global original-gradient admission remains fresh and unchanged.

workAbi.storageScope: Numeric/vector payloads only. Allocator/container overhead and transient factorization maps are not a total-memory measurement.

sectionNumericsV3.rightPreconditioning: Free direction P*g, g=A^T*r, P=A^T*C^-2*A, is SPD on range(A^T). Apply the existing exact forward/reverse factors twice, then minimize against the unweighted original A-action and residual with complete two-pass reorthogonalization. This numerical partition adds no physical support, omits no physical row, projects no load/null mode, and introduces no rank threshold or pivot shift.

sectionFactorAdmission.change: Reject nonfinite narrowed coefficients and any zero signed/permuted Cholesky diagonal; permit ordinary f32 rounding of off-diagonal coefficients to zero.
sectionFactorAdmission.rankArgument: Native factor row i corresponds to physical lower-factor row (i+3)%6. Reversing the permutation and angular signs yields a lower triangular factor. Every diagonal coefficient is required nonzero, so its determinant is nonzero and the represented K=S*S^T is positive definite in exact arithmetic. No diagonal regularization or off-diagonal epsilon cutoff is introduced.
sectionFactorAdmission.compatibility: Every formerly admitted coefficient and recurrence remains byte-identical. Only formerly terminal-rejected input states are newly admitted. Sections numerical revision2 remains valid; legacy and original physical revision1 are unchanged.
sectionFactorAdmission.nativeValidation: Pending independent strict manufactured and full-graph receipts; this provenance record is not an acceptance verdict.
